Faces are small in the wides (zoom 1.0: a head is about 55 px); every key expression is given a close or two-shot. Do not let the wides carry acting.
Four mounted riders plus two on-foot actors is the heaviest frame (S2 wide, S10): keep the two rear riders simple (idle, staggered) and check the frame time.
rideOn clips the rider at the saddle and shows the front-facing person; riders cannot turn in profile, so "looking back" is done with gaze and a small head offset only.

The lie pose on the donkey (reclineOnMount) is untested on a mount: check a still at 124.5 and 128.4 before animating the rest; fallback is the Bedouin sitting astride and leaning far back (tip -0.5).
